notes.title: Welcome To The Pluriverse - One Story, Many Journeys
notes.notes:
I have been thinking a lot recently about how we frame the story of humankind. About who tells this story. Who frames the story. And how we can tell it differently in video games compared to in books. 

[b]Welcome to the Pluriverse! One Story, Many Journeys[/b]

All these thoughts are flowing into my design process of the level selection menu right now.
I believe the story of humankind needs to be told by many voices, telling the stories of their many cultures - yet still being at home in the same meta story. That is how my idea for the pluriverse was born. If you want to hear more, I created a new devlog for you where I dive deeper into all of this and more: 

[previewyoutube=d39ZpjqcVDM;full][/previewyoutube]

Or find it on my YouTube channel here: 

https://youtu.be/d39ZpjqcVDM

Integrating all these learnings is a slow process at times. One I cannot push or pull or box into deadlines. So I am giving it the time that it needs to become what it wants to become. 

I would love to hear your thoughts on all of this. What kind of story of humankind do we need right now? How would you frame this story? Who should tell which part of that story? I'd be very happy to read a comment on my YouTube video from you. This way we can continue the conversation and spread the word for more people to join the conversation. 

Hope you are all doing well!

Ani

notes.title: Devlog: Creating Colorful Worlds
notes.notes:
"Oh, I really like the colors" is a reaction I often get from people when I show them the game. 
It makes me happy every time. One of my goals is to create worlds that players really enjoy to be in and one way to achieve that is through colors.  

Lately I have been working on the color schemes again, so I wanted to share how I apply color theory to create my levels. I share my workflow within Photoshop and Unity and give examples of my thought process applied to several of my levels. 

Once in a while, I create devlogs on my Youtube channel to share my progress on the game.
So if you are interested in learning more about the game and the development, feel free to check it out!

See you next time! 

[previewyoutube=Qo34gvMJX78;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Welcome everyone! ^-^ Glad you are here!
notes.notes:
[b][h3]Hey everyone and welcome to the page! [/h3] [/b]

My name is Anneke and I am the solo developer behind "The Human Story". 

For the past several months I was preparing artworks, screenshots, a teaser trailer and the right words to describe the heart of the game and it feels [i]really good[/i] to finally share this page with you now.

I have been on this development journey for about three years now. During that time I have been creating the foundations for the game, iterating the core game play and researching the content. 
This project is dear to my heart. Creating it is my way of making sense of the world and I am just as drawn to making the game as on the first day. 

I will post my progress here from time to time, as well as on other social media platforms. 
[b]Feel free to come visit me there. I am always happy to get feedback.[/b] 

On my youtube channel I upload devlogs every once in a while: 
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCFm-maNxR4Ur3zN68pKVWgA

On twitter and facebook I post major updates: 
https://twitter.com/AnnekeLisa

https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=100085956050572

If you want to get notified when the game is out, press the [b]wishlist[/b] button on the steam page. 

[i]Thanks for your interest and support <3[/i]

Anneke Lisa
